{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Compute conversion rates within each segment and channel
stratified_conversion = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Pivot to get email and paid_search conversion per segment
pivoted = stratified_conversion.pivot(index='customer_segment', columns='channel', values='converted')

# Now extract the columns correctly
email_conv = pivoted['email']
paid_search_conv = pivoted['paid_search']

diffs = email_conv - paid_search_conv

# Compute segment sizes in email channel
email_segment_sizes = sales_df[sales_df['channel'] == 'email']['customer_segment'].value_counts()

# Weighted average difference
total_email = email_segment_sizes.sum()
weighted_diff = (diffs * email_segment_sizes).sum() / total_email

pivoted, email_conv, paid_search_conv, diffs, weighted_diff"}
